role: Git ignore rules for build output, Xcode user state, IDE files, OS junk, env files, archives, signing/secret material and internal working material.
toplevel: Ignores: build/, DerivedData/, *.pbxuser/mode*/perspectivev3 (except default.*), xcuserdata/, *.moved-aside, *.xccheckout, *.xcscmblueprint, *.hmap, *.ipa, *.dSYM(.zip), timeline.xctimeline, playground.xcworkspace, .swiftpm/xcode/ and .swiftpm/configuration/ (Package.resolved is NOT ignored, so the lockfile under Emuqu.xcodeproj is committed), Carthage/Build/, Dependencies/, .accio/, fastlane report/preview/screenshots/test_output, iOSInjectionProject/, macOS/Windows/Linux junk files, .claude/ (AI tooling state, line 111), .vscode/, .idea/, *.iml, vim swap files, .env/.env.local/.env.*.local (125-128), *.xcarchive, *.mobileprovision/*.provisionprofile, Crashlytics property files, *.pem/*.p12/*.p8/*.key/credentials.json/secrets.json (163-170; comment says testflight.yml writes an App Store Connect .p8 at build time), do_not_ship/ (AI audit prompts, research prompts, hardware-gated plans, the code map's findings overlay and validation run output, kept out of public history) and Tools/validation/results/ (output of the validate_*.py runs). Also ignores .venv-codemap/ (the code-map tooling venv made by make codemap-setup), .codemap-python/ (the standalone CPython codemap-setup downloads when no Python 3.10+ is installed) and __pycache__/ (Python bytecode, written when the code-map scripts import each other). The macOS custom-folder-icon rule is `Icon` followed by two carriage returns (bytes I c o n \r \r \n): git strips one CR as a CRLF line end, so the pattern ignores files named `Icon\r` and not a file literally named `Icon`.
